blocks.content: Demo — we solve this one together. No answer box should appear below it.

1. If $2x + 5 = 17$, what is the value of $x$?
(A) $4$    (B) $5$    (C) $6$    (D) $7$
2. What is the slope of the line through $(1, 1)$ and $(4, 7)$?    (grid-in)
Work on paper. Enter only your final answer. You will not be told whether you are right until we review together.
3. $$x = \frac{40}{x + 3}$$ What is the negative solution to the given equation?    (grid-in)
4. Line $p$ is defined by $4y + 8x = 6$. Line $r$ is perpendicular to line $p$ in the $xy$-plane. What is the slope of line $r$?    (grid-in)

5. Which of the following is equivalent to $(2x - 3)(x + 5)$?
(A) $2x^2 + 7x - 15$    (B) $2x^2 - 7x - 15$    (C) $2x^2 + 7x + 15$    (D) $2x^2 + 13x - 15$

6. If $f(3x) = x - 6$ for all $x$, what is the value of $f(6)$?
(A) $-6$    (B) $-4$    (C) $0$    (D) $2$
